sentences.en: It's simply that aversion to failure is hardwired into our culture, and this cultural influence affects decisions founders make when things don't go according to plan.

sentences.en: Made of sturdy cast aluminum for many years of useful service, Hampton Bay outdoor wall lights are hardwired but easy to install.

sentences.en: Some believe that the human brain may be hardwired, or genetically programed, to find the shapes and proportions of the Golden Ratio aesthetically pleasing.

sentences.en: In some ways, physical fitness means going beyond what the body is hardwired to do, namely, store fat in order to have the necessary energy stores to function.

sentences.en: Dogs are pack animals that are hardwired to respond to a distinct pack hierarchy.
